record_title: Completeness and angular collapse in Sylvester-power covariance metrics
provenance: Geometric analysis of the parameterized covariance-matrix kernel metric introduced in arXiv:2609.17089, compared with established kernel-metric completeness theory in arXiv:0809.4974, arXiv:2109.05768, and arXiv:2111.02990.
limitations: The angular-collapse result is an upper bound from an explicit isospectral rotation path, not an exact geodesic distance or an optimization convergence theorem. The completeness lemma applies to smooth positive homogeneous kernel metrics, not arbitrary O(n)-invariant metrics.
